**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW)**

- **What the document says:** Section 11 (p0043) picks "the laws of the Arizona" with no venue provision. Section 19 (p0053–p0056) then imposes mandatory binding arbitration under the U.S. Arbitration & Mediation rules, with awards confirmable in the district of the residence of the losing party.
- **Why it fails:** Arizona is outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales), so the clause misses both the preferred and fallback positions on a material term. The arbitration is domestic rather than seated abroad, so it is not walk-away, but no accepted forum is designated anywhere.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** Arizona → State of New York, plus exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County; arbitration seated in New York County so the forum tracks the governing law. Rest of both sentences left intact per the redline guidance, and Delaware/California/England and Wales flagged as acceptable fallbacks in the comment.
